Description: Catches any value assigned to a common secret/key/token/password variable name, regardless of entropy. Deliberately excludes '.' from the value charset so os.environ/... and os.getenv(...) reference patterns don't match (they stop at the first '.', falling below the 6-char minimum) — those are safe indirection, not literal secrets.
